basics.name: Jim leirvik
basics.label: Developer
basics.summary: Proactive Fullstack Developer with experience building enterprise-grade applications and internal tools. Skilled in backend and frontend development, DevOps, and regulated environments. Known for initiative, problem-solving, and creating solutions that improve team workflows.

work.name: Edlib AS
work.description: Edlib develops web-based solutions for e-learning and digital education platforms, aiming to become a leading international player in innovative learning technology.
work.summary: Worked on various projects, including consulting on complex healthcare-related systems and internal platforms.
highlights: Lead role in a new Django project to build a new platform for Edlib AS.
Consulted on a healthcare application with an extensive Kubernetes-based microservice architecture.
Participated in ISO certification processes for healthcare systems and security solutions through training, testing, and documentation.
Developed and maintained backend services in Java and frontend applications using Ionic and Angular.
Initiated, designed, and implemented a solution that improved daily workflows for the support staff, receiving internal recognition for impact and execution.

work.name: Bilberry Technologies
work.description: Bilberry has designed a powerful, flexible, and focused platform that takes the everyday operations of activity providers to the next level.
work.summary: Worked on frontend development for both their legacy and new platforms.
highlights: Ownership of OKR to establish a foundation for a quality culture with the goal to reduce the number of unique issues by 70%.
Worked across teams and projects to improve end-to-end and acceptance testing.
Initiated and motivated colleagues to participate in CTF (Cyberlandslaget 2025).

work.name: Cerpus AS
work.description: Cerpus develops web-based e-learning solutions and is working towards becoming an international leader in innovative educational solutions.
work.summary: Worked on a platform offering gamified educational content for schools used worldwide. The platform was based on Laravel, and the games were built for both mobile and browser using JavaScript.
highlights: Led implementation of a new design across the entire platform and components.
Contributed to research, development, implementation, and launch of three successful JavaScript games on the platform.

work.name: Ahlsell AS
work.description: Ahlsell is a wholesaler for professional users with an extensive range of products and related services. With an annual turnover of approximately 50 billion SEK, 7,500 employees, and over 300 stores.
work.summary: Lead role for tender calculations, including supplier and customer contact for all major tenders in Northern Norway, both for contractors and municipalities.
highlights: Participated in a project group developing and implementing new routines for offer follow-up and tracking, including CRM integrations.

work.name: Ahlsell AS
work.summary: Managed sales and customer relations for 50 clients in the water and wastewater (VA) sector, including small and large contractors and municipalities.
highlights: Increased sales and expanded the department's customer base.
Primary responsibility for procurement agreement with 13 municipalities in Salten.
Developed integration between tender calculation software and ISY Linker enabling digital offers.
Designed and implemented digital tender tracking and project systems that automated workflows, integrated internal and external data sources, and were adopted region-wide.
Contributed to sales, project calculations, and tracking across the region.
Participated in a project group developing new guidelines for tender management.
Supported implementation of new national framework agreements for the VA sector, benefiting 200 customers and simplifying staff workflows.

work.name: Braathe Gruppen
work.description: Braathe Gruppen is a forward-thinking technology provider with a vision to deliver a worry-free IT experience.
work.summary: Worked on a large Norwegian auction website. Analyzed customer needs and opportunities, then implemented solutions using Symfony and JavaScript.
highlights: Organized a project team of three developers and leadership.
Introduced the use of virtual environments for development.
Improved workflows by optimizing issue tracking, version control, and CI/CD.

work.name: International Software Technology AS
work.description: Nordic company providing administrative and educational IT solutions.
work.summary: Part of an international team working on school administration software. Implemented new features, bug fixes, and internal/external API integrations.
highlights: Contributed to project modernization, including updates to the tech stack and tools such as Gulp, SASS, and Vagrant.

work.name: Leirvik Nett
work.summary: Handled tender calculations, customer and project sourcing domestically and internationally, and followed up on offers. Analyzed customer needs and implemented solutions.

skills.name: Back End Development
skills.summary: Builds and maintains APIs and services in Go, PHP, Node, and Python. Works with relational and document databases, Redis, RabbitMQ, and BaaS (e.g. Supabase). Integrates internal and third-party systems; designs for security and long-term maintainability.

skills.name: Front End Development
skills.summary: Delivers UIs in React and Vue with TypeScript, Tailwind, and CSS. Works from Figma through implementation: semantic, reusable components, sensible UX, and Playwright tests where they add value.

skills.name: DevOps
skills.summary: Uses Docker and Kubernetes in real workflows; deploys and operates on AWS. Outside work, runs homelab services on real hardware with a segmented network (VLANs, pfSense)—hands-on practice with networking, reliability, and automation.

skills.name: Security
skills.summary: Web and API security, network architecture, and endpoint hardening—through consulting and long-running personal work. Assumes breach: limits blast radius with segmentation (VLANs), strict trust boundaries.

sideProjects.description: The website and forums were built using Joomla CMS and vBulletin, with custom-developed components to integrate with our e-commerce partner, shipping providers, and subscription services for website and forum access. A custom vBulletin module was also created to allow club partners to advertise their products and services, offering promotions. The club has since discontinued operations.
